characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a loose, knee‑length linen tunic in muted sage green with a simple white collar that falls to her waist. Over the tunic she dons a thick woolen apron dyed deep burgundy, fastened at the neck by a leather strap and tied around her hips with a wide brown belt. Her lower body is covered by sturdy leather breeches tucked into worn, calf‑high leather boots polished to a dark sheen. She wears fingerless leather gloves on both hands for polishing the oak counter. No hat or additional headwear is present
characters.role: medieval barkeep taking care of a tavern for magical humanoid creatures
